newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong cook jailed for killing amorous boss.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong cook jailed for killing amorous boss.

text.p: A Chinese dimsum cook was jailed for life by a Hong Kong court for killing his boss and carving up her body after claiming she had become too amorous, a newspaper said on Friday.
The chef, Zeng Liang-xin from mainland China, screamed for mercy as a judge sentenced him to life imprisonment on Thursday, the South China Morning Post said.
Zeng had told the court he accidently killed Wong Miu-kuen, the 37-year-old manager of the restaurant in which he worked, after she offered him money for sex.
Wong died when her head bashed a bunk bed after she was shoved to the floor, Zeng said.
He admitted stealing the woman's jewels as he hacked off her head and chopped her up in an attempt to conceal her death.
